name: How do I know if I need new windows?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if I need new windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs you may need new windows include noticeable drafts, condensation between glass panes, difficulty opening or closing windows, decaying frames, or rising energy bills. If your windows are old, single-pane, or show visible signs of wear and tear, replacement is likely beneficial. Upgrading can address comfort issues and improve your home's overall performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for drafts, condensation, difficulty operating windows, decaying frames, or high energy bills as signs you need new windows.
